ma.getNetworkType(Object object)

Obtain the network type.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getNetworkType:ok
networkType String Network type.
isConnectVPN String Is the VPN enabled
signalStrength Number Signal strength, unit dbm (Android only)

Valid value of networkType

Valid Value Description
Wifi Wi-Fi Network
2g 2G network
3g 3G Network
4g 4G Network
5g 5G Network
unknown Uncommon network type in Android
none The device has no network connection.

Valid value of isConnectVPN(The minimum version is 25.9.0)

Valid Value Description
true VPN enabled
false VPN turned off

Sample Code

ma.getNetworkType({
  success(res) {
    const networkType = res.networkType;
    if (res.isConnectVPN) {
        console.log("The current device is using a VPN");
    } else {
        console.log("The current device is not using a VPN");
    }
  }
});

Bug & Tips

  1. When connected to VPN while using Wi-Fi, or when all network connections are disabled, network reachability verification is required. Since this involves API requests, it may take some time. It is recommended to show a loading indicator during the process.
